allowedHosts.title: Allowed vCenter hosts
allowedHosts.description: Hostnames where TypeThru may send text, e.g. vcenter.example.com or *.example.com. When set, users cannot change the list. Empty or unset: every host is allowed (users can set their own list).

defaultLayout.title: Default VM keyboard layout
defaultLayout.description: Keyboard layout of the VMs (as set inside the guest OS), preselected until the user chooses one: us, de, de-ch, fr, uk, es, it. Without this policy TypeThru guesses from the browser language.
